''' Sashana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] and the [[War against Zakuul|ensuing conflict]] with the [[Eternal Empire]]. The Eternal Empire campaign saw Jedi numbers thin over time, leading to surviving Jedi going underground. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] recruited her to join him on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Sashana was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She would eventually rise to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Sashana would be one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to join Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] in hiding on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in the aftermath of the [[Eternal Empire conquest|surprise attack]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] on both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sashana would be on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[3628 BBY]] when the Sith Empire sent their forces to eliminate the Jedi stationed on Ossus. Sashana would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial spacer sent to eliminate the Jedi in the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sashana first appeared in the [[2018]] update for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''. She serves as the final boss for Imperial Players in the Heroic Mission Consume The Light .<ref name="TOR" />
